g.text: Consensus Spectral Graph — 50 Local Spectral Motifs, edges weighted by seven-feature merge confidence
red edges are pairs co-assigned at EVERY viable significance level (the merge proposals);
the outer ring holds the 30 motifs that never join one. Grey edges are the strongest non-unanimous evidence.
